title: GIP-[XXX]: Blockscout SLA and Hosting Renewal (January 2027 - December 2027)
headline: A draft Gnosis funding proposal asks for $106,800 to renew Blockscout explorer hosting and SLA for 2027.
summary: A draft Gnosis improvement proposal from the Blockscout team asks GnosisDAO to fund a one-year renewal (January to December 2027) of its service agreement and hosting for the Gnosis block explorer, API and developer infrastructure. The requested amount is $106,800, which the author says is about 7% lower than the 2025 proposal because of database optimizations and storage savings. It replaces GIP-144. The author says everything committed in GIP-144 was delivered, including a Universal Bridge Indexer for the Gnosis bridge, a standalone open-source service that indexes cross-chain activity and is integrated into the explorer UI and API. The author also says Gnosis was able to cancel a previous Etherscan support contract, saving a large annual cost. The post is a draft with a placeholder GIP number, and the vote shows no voters yet. Open questions: the full deliverables list for 2027, and how the claimed savings were measured.
